descriptionByLocale.it:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 225 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Business Risk Manager (80-100%) - LO Patrimonia LO Patrimonia is an entity of Lombard Odier Group providing wealth planning and fiduciary services. With a team of forty experts whose skills cover Switzerland, the main European jurisdictions and other regions of the world, LO Patrimonia serves clients of the Lombard Odier Group exclusively. To cope with a growing and challenging regulatory environment, we are looking for a Risk and Control Officer. The person will maintain an operational risk control plan and perform controls to ensure LO Patrimonia complies with its regulatory obligations and mitigates risks in accordance with Lombard Odier Group’s requirements. This includes the improvement of operational efficiency of tools and processes. The person will work closely with LO Patrimonia’s management and legal/compliance responsible person as well as collaborate with other departments of Lombard Odier Group in the field of risk, operational and technology management. YOUR MISSION
• Maintain LO Patrimonia’s risk control environment including governance, risk committee and reportings in accordance with Group Risk’s requirements
• Monitor activities and perform and/or consolidate controls for the risk committee
• Perform controls to monitor LO Patrimonia’s compliancy with regulatory obligations
• Act as data owner
• Act as Business Risk Manager and support LO Patrimonia’s management to comply with Lombard Odier Group Risk’ requirements
• Coordinate Internal Audit requests with relevant stakeholders and implement recommendations
• Manage the delivery of multiple projects requested by LO Patrimonia’s management or legal/compliance responsible person from initial analysis to implementation
• Collaborate to wider legal and regulatory projects initiated from other departments of the Lombard Odier Group and with the assistance of the department in charge of operations and organization
• Lead a variety of projects, ranging from electronic signature implementation to document management (GED) initiatives YOUR PROFILE
• Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience in banking or fiduciary environment in a similar role or equivalent
• Good knowledge of regulatory requirements of Swiss Law, specifically FINMA’s circulars on AML and risk topics, corporate law, AMLA, FADP and cross-border rules (soft law)
• Good experience in the fields of compliance and risk researches and controls
• Knowledge of SQL language and overall understanding of IT hardware and software in order to be able to exchange with IT persons and popularize for non IT persons
• Proficient level with Microsoft office tools, especially Excel, Powerpoint, Adobe acrobat and ability to self-learn other applications
• Versatile, analytical, long term oriented, good interpersonal skills, willing to learn, tenacious, team player and communicator
• Fluent in French and English
• Resident in Switzerland Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at wh

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 225 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Senior Compliance Assurance Officer (80-100%) Group Compliance Assurance è un team dedicato all'interno del dipartimento di conformità di Lombard Odier. Il team con sede in Svizzera è responsabile dell'attuazione del Piano di Assicurazione Compliance per le nostre entità svizzere e straniere. La portata delle attività del team è in linea con il mandato del Dipartimento Compliance, si concentra principalmente sui rischi legati alla criminalità finanziaria / sanzioni e contribuisce materialmente al nostro quadro di Compliance Consolidated Supervision. Le attività del team hanno costituito un approccio previsionale, al fine di tradurre i risultati delle attività di assicurazione basate sul rischio in miglioramenti misurabili nell'ambiente di controllo Compliance. Il tuo! Con sede a Ginevra e segnalazione al Capo della Assicurazione Compliance di Gruppo, valuterai (i) la progettazione e l'efficacia operativa dei controlli pertinenti; (ii) il rispetto delle leggi e dei regolamenti applicabili e l'aderenza ai nostri standard di conformità e alle politiche interne del Gruppo Lombard Odier come segue:
• Sviluppare i piani di prova e di revisione, compreso il mantenimento di un inventario degli script di prova.
• Eseguire e/o supervisionare le attività di test e/o revisione
• Valutare i risultati del test e rivedere e comunicare i risultati preliminari agli stakeholder
• Risultati di documenti e loro disposizione come questioni e azioni in consultazione con i proprietari di emissione.
• Finalizzare e distribuire report alle parti interessate.
• Monitorare il completamento dei problemi e delle azioni attraverso la chiusura per la segnalazione della gestione.
• Preparare e segnalare le metriche di stato del progresso come richiesto
• Coordinare le attività di controllo della conformità con altre seconde unità di difesa e Gruppo Internal Audit
• Fornire consigli e indicazioni all'ufficio frontale sulle azioni per migliorare la conformità in relazione ai risultati dei test e delle recensioni
• Proporre e contribuire a progetti per migliorare continuamente l'ambiente di controllo per i rischi legati alla conformità e altre iniziative interfunzionali rilevanti
• In conformità con gli standard professionali di Lombard Odier, ci si aspetterà di rispettare tutti i requisiti di conformità legali, regolamentari e interni applicabili, inclusi, ma non limitati al Codice di condotta e di conformità del Gruppo. Si prevede inoltre di mantenere tutte le certificazioni professionali, come applicabile, per essere pienamente qualificati per svolgere il vostro ruolo, compreso il completamento di tutte le formazioni obbligatorie necessarie per ottenere e mantenere tali certificazioni. Il tuo progetto qualifiche richieste/istruzione
• Laurea in diritto, economia, finanza o settore relativo
• Certificazione professionale supplementare nel rispetto di un vantaggio Esperienza / conoscenza necessaria
• Una solida comprensione degli ambienti normativi, in particolare del quadro svizzero e dell'organizzazione della vigilanza consolidata
• Almeno 10 anni di esperienza rilevante nei servizi finanziari nel settore pubblico o privato, con particolare esposizione al private banking
• Esperienza in conformità o audit ro

Senior Compliance Assurance Officer (80-100%) Group Compliance Assurance is a dedicated team within Lombard Odier's Compliance department. The team based in Switzerland is responsible for implementing the Group Compliance Assurance Plan for our Swiss and foreign entities. The scope of the team's activities is in line with the mandate of the Compliance Department, focuses primarily on risks related to financial crime / sanctions and materially contributes to our Compliance Consolidated Supervision framework. The team's activities embed a forward-looking approach, with a view to translate the results of risk-based assurance activities into measurable improvements in the Compliance control environment. YOUR ROLE Based in Geneva and reporting to the Head of Group Compliance Assurance, you will assess (i) the design and operating effectiveness of relevant controls; (ii) compliance with applicable laws and regulations and adherence to our Compliance standards and internal policies for the Group Lombard Odier as follows:
• Develop the testing and review plans, including maintaining an inventory of test scripts.
• Perform and/or supervise testing and/or review activities
• Evaluate test and review results and communicate preliminary findings to stakeholders
• Document findings and their disposition as issues and actions in consultation with issue owners.
• Finalise and distribute reports to stakeholders.
• Monitor the completion of issues and actions through to issue closure for management reporting.
• Prepare and report progress status metrics as required
• Coordinate compliance assurance activities with other second line of defence units and Group Internal Audit
• Provide advice and guidance to the front office on actions to improve compliance in relation to the results of testing and reviews
• Propose and contribute to projects to continuously improve the control environment for compliance-related risks and other relevant cross-functional initiatives
• In accordance with Lombard Odier's professional standards, you will be expected to comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements, including but not limited to the Group Code of Conduct and Compliance Policies and Procedures. You will also be expected to maintain all professional certifications, as applicable, to be fully qualified to perform your role, including completing all mandatory training required to obtain and maintain such certifications. • Degree in law, economics, finance or a related field
• Additional professional certification in compliance an advantage Experience/knowledge required
• Solid understanding of regulatory environments, particularly of the Swiss framework and the organization of consolidated supervision
• At least 10 years of relevant experience in financial services in the public or private sector, with particular exposure to private banking
• Experience in a compliance or audit ro

Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 225 Jahre langen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Senior Compliance Assurance Officer (80-100%) Group Compliance Assurance ist ein engagiertes Team innerhalb der Compliance-Abteilung von Lombard Odier. Das in der Schweiz ansässige Team ist für die Umsetzung des Group Compliance Assurance Plans für unsere Schweizer und ausländischen Unternehmen verantwortlich. Der Umfang der Aktivitäten des Teams entspricht dem Mandat der Compliance-Abteilung, konzentriert sich in erster Linie auf Risiken im Zusammenhang mit Finanzkriminalität / Sanktionen und trägt maßgeblich zu unserem Compliance-Konsolidierten Aufsichtsrahmen bei. Die Aktivitäten des Teams stellten einen zukunftsweisenden Ansatz dar, um die Ergebnisse von risikobasierten Sicherungsmaßnahmen in messbare Verbesserungen in der Compliance-Kontrollumgebung umzusetzen. IHRE ROLLE Mit Sitz in Genf und der Berichterstattung an den Konzernleiter Compliance Assurance bewerten Sie (i) die Gestaltung und operative Wirksamkeit relevanter Kontrollen; (ii) die Einhaltung geltender Gesetze und Vorschriften und Einhaltung unserer Compliance-Standards und internen Richtlinien für die Gruppe Lombard Odier wie folgt:
• Entwicklung der Test- und Überprüfungspläne, einschließlich der Aufrechterhaltung eines Inventars von Testskripten.
• Durchführung und/oder Überwachung von Prüf- und/oder Prüftätigkeiten
• Prüf- und Prüfergebnisse bewerten und vorläufige Befunde an die Beteiligten übermitteln
• Dokumentenbefunde und ihre Disposition als Themen und Aktionen in Abstimmung mit Emittenten.
• Abschluss und Verbreitung von Berichten an Interessenvertreter.
• Überwachen Sie die Fertigstellung von Problemen und Aktionen, um eine Schließung für die Management-Berichterstattung auszulösen.
• Bereiten und melden Sie die Fortschrittsstatus-Metriken nach Bedarf
• Koordinierte Compliance-Versicherungsaktivitäten mit anderen zweiten Verteidigungseinheiten und internem Audit der Gruppe
• Beratung und Beratung an der Frontstelle über Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Einhaltung der Ergebnisse von Tests und Überprüfungen
• Förderung von Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Kontrollumfelds für konforme Risiken und andere relevante funktionsübergreifende Initiativen
• In Übereinstimmung mit den professionellen Standards von Lombard Odier wird erwartet, dass Sie alle geltenden gesetzlichen, regulatorischen und internen Compliance-Anforderungen einhalten, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf den Gruppenkodex für Verhaltens- und Compliance-Politiken und -Verfahren. Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 225 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Agent principal d'assurance de la conformité (80-100%) Group Compliance Assurance est une équipe dédiée au département Conformité de Lombard Odier. L'équipe basée en Suisse est responsable de la mise en œuvre du plan d'assurance de la conformité du Groupe pour nos entités suisses et étrangères. La portée des activités de l'équipe est conforme au mandat du Département de la conformité, se concentre principalement sur les risques liés à la criminalité financière et aux sanctions et contribue de façon significative à notre cadre de surveillance consolidée de la conformité. Les activités de l'équipe intègrent une approche tournée vers l'avenir, en vue de traduire les résultats des activités d'assurance axées sur les risques en améliorations mesurables de l'environnement de contrôle de la conformité. Votre rôle Basé à Genève et relevant du Chef de Groupe Assurance de Conformité, vous évaluerez (i) la conception et l'efficacité opérationnelle des contrôles pertinents; (ii) le respect des lois et règlements applicables et le respect de nos normes de Conformité et politiques internes pour le Groupe Lombard Odier comme suit:
• Élaborer des plans d'essai et d'examen, y compris tenir un inventaire des scripts d'essai.
• Effectuer et/ou superviser des essais et/ou des examens
• Évaluer et examiner les résultats et communiquer les conclusions préliminaires aux parties prenantes
• Documenter les résultats et leur disposition en tant que questions et actions en consultation avec les propriétaires de questions.
• Finaliser et distribuer les rapports aux parties prenantes.
• Surveiller l'achèvement des problèmes et des actions en mettant fin aux rapports de gestion.
• Préparer et faire rapport sur l'état d'avancement des travaux au besoin;
• Coordonner les activités d'assurance de la conformité avec les autres unités de défense de deuxième ligne et l'audit interne du groupe
• Fournir des conseils et des conseils au front office sur les mesures à prendre pour améliorer la conformité aux résultats des essais et des examens;
• Proposer et contribuer à des projets visant à améliorer continuellement l'environnement de contrôle des risques liés à la conformité et à d'autres initiatives interfonctionnelles pertinentes;
• Conformément aux normes professionnelles de Lombard Odier, vous devrez respecter toutes les exigences légales, réglementaires et internes applicables en matière de conformité, y compris le code de conduite et les politiques et procédures de conformité du groupe. Vous devrez également conserver toutes les certifications professionnelles, selon le cas, pour être pleinement qualifié pour remplir votre rôle, y compris remplir toute la formation obligatoire requise pour obtenir et maintenir ces certifications. VOTRE PROFIL Diplômes/études requis
• Diplôme en droit, économie, finance ou domaine connexe
• Certification professionnelle supplémentaire en conformité un avantage Expérience/connaissance requise
• Une bonne compréhension des environnements réglementaires, notamment du cadre suisse et de l'organisation d'une surveillance consolidée
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience pertinente dans les services financiers dans le secteur public ou privé, avec une exposition particulière à la banque privée
• Expérience en matière de conformité ou d'audit

We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Head of IT Security Operations & Controls (80-100%) The CISO organization protects Lombard Odier and our Clients against the risk of data theft and business disruption due to cyber-attacks or malicious insiders. The team is composed of approx. 15 talented team members that cover all aspects of security for the Group. Reporting to our Chief Information Security Officer, you will lead the bank’s Operational Security function - owning our SoC (analysts and engineering), incident response, and the effectiveness of our frontline security controls. Your mission is to maximize the safe use of our digital assets, protect customers information, and keep the business fast, compliant, and resilient. YOUR ROLE
• Manage a team of approx. 4 individuals: hiring, coaching, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers.
• SoC leadership & incident response: Run day‑to‑day SoC operations, elevate detection & response maturity, and lead major incident command calmly under pressure. Ensure investigations are rigorous, evidence‑based, and drive tactical fixes as well as strategic improvements.
• Strategy & modernization: Define and execute the SoC strategy for the next 2–3 years, including pragmatic adoption of cloud and AI‑assisted threat detection, triage, and automation (SOAR).
• Security control operations: Own the operating effectiveness of key controls (e.g., vulnerability management, baseline security, DLP). Ensure continuous control monitoring, coverage metrics, and clear KRIs/KPIs that matter to the business.
• Establish, own, and execute the bank’s penetration testing, red team, and purple team roadmap -coordinating internal capabilities and external partners to simulate realistic adversary behaviors and ensure continuous improvement of detection, response, and control effectiveness.
• Oversee the operational workflow of the security team, including triaging incoming support tickets, security requests, and operational tasks. Ensure efficient dispatching and prioritization of work across the CISO organization and maintain clear service‑level expectations with internal stakeholders.
• Enterprise & engineering integration: Partner closely with Architecture, Engineering, Infrastructure, IT Ops, and Developers to land controls and patterns that scale.
• Resilience & recovery: Strengthen incident readiness, tabletop exercises, and post‑incident “close‑call” learning to boost resilience and reduce repeat issues.
• Stakeholder trust: Engage customers, auditors, and internal leaders; translate risk into clear business context; advocate for secure‑by‑default choices. YOUR PROFILE
• 10+ years in cybersecurity with direct leadership of SoC and Incident Response functions, including people leadership (hiring, coaching, performance).
• Demonstrated success running security operations in complex environments (on‑premise and cloud)
• Strong systems thinking; you connect detections, controls, processes, and behaviors into a coherent
